implementation.accountEntry: History remains reachable with both rewards capabilities OFF; failed refreshes retain prior coin values and config with an error.
implementation.walletReads: Balance, history, and config use explicit required-read states. Initial failure does not display a zero balance or empty history; failed refresh keeps prior data and offers retry.
implementation.noticeStorage: Denomination notice storage is an independent optional state; its read/write errors do not replace successful wallet data.
implementation.emptyHistory: The empty state only mentions eligible completed bookings when earning is explicitly enabled; paused earning does not promise new rewards.
implementation.ledgerPresentation: Retains all six existing ledger kinds, signed paise values, dates, expiry, reasons, denomination conversion, and Seva Coins non-cash/non-transferable wording.
implementation.moneyBehavior: No calculation, API, authorization, RLS, refund/clawback, feature-flag, SQL function/object, or migration changes.
